description: Screening Autopilot settings. Shows the employer's own Screening Autopilot settings: a thank-you message to every applicant, a match level at which applicants are moved to the shortlist for the employer to review, and an optional polite turn-down after a number of days without a decision. Each is off unless the employer turns it on. A ready-to-read summary is in `say`.
name: get_screening_autopilot
title: Screening Autopilot settings
